trap_summary_zh: 门店月面板中广告、销售、节假日、人流等共同变动；Operations note 披露策略 RET-ADV-ROLL（当月广告预算为上月店内销售收入之固定比例）。简单做 sales~ad_spend 或单凭 ROI 放大预算，易把相关当成因果；应识别混杂/机械联动并限缩可支持的因果与预算叙事。

content: Analysis flags holiday/season confounding (e.g. is_holiday_month) and does not treat bivariate ad–sales association as a causal effect without caveats.
keywords: holiday or seasonal confounding is discussed.
Causal language is qualified for observational monthly data.
